headline: Russian Drone Wave Strikes Kyiv Region as Ukrainian USVs Sink Corvette Near Libya
subheadline: Over 30 Shahed and reactive UAV groups launched from six Russian airbases; a reactive Shahed struck Vyshneve's Novus shopping center.
lede: Russian forces launched a massive coordinated drone assault across Ukraine overnight, with over 30 Shahed and reactive UAV groups targeting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Odesa, and other regions. A reactive Shahed struck the Novus shopping center in Vyshneve, Kyiv region, and search-and-rescue operations recovered a live child from the rubble. Ukrainian unmanned surface vessels attacked and sank the Russian corvette Mercury near Libya and damaged the sanctioned Russian roller ASCALON carrying military equipment. In the Middle East, Iran launched two missiles from Ahvaz with air defense activity in Khuzestan and West Azerbaijan, while Lebanon's southern border recorded 149 alerts and a Hermes-450 drone armed with four missiles was observed over Beirut's southern suburb.

sections.title: Massed Drone Assault and Maritime Strike
sections.body: Russian forces launched Shahed and reactive UAVs from at least six airbases including Primorsko-Akhtarsk, Orel, Millerovo, Gvardeyskoye, Shatalovo, and Kursk, targeting multiple Ukrainian regions simultaneously. A reactive Shahed struck the Novus shopping center in Vyshneve, prompting search-and-rescue operations that extracted a live child from the rubble. Ukrainian unmanned surface vessels sank the Russian corvette Mercury near Libya and damaged the sanctioned Russian roller ASCALON carrying military equipment. Ukrainian forces repelled Russian advances near Ustynivka in Donetsk region, while Russian troops progressed near Verkhnya Tersa.

sections.title: Iran Missile Launches and Lebanon Border Alerts
sections.body: Iran experienced two missile launches from Ahvaz in Khuzestan Province, with air defense activity reported in Ramhormoz and UAV activity over Urmia. Israeli airstrikes in Gaza City killed two and wounded several, while rocket sirens activated in Even Menahem and Shtula along the Lebanon confrontation line. Lebanon border monitoring recorded 149 alerts including 89 drone detections and 34 artillery shelling incidents, concentrated in Nabatieh and Tyre districts. A Hermes-450 drone armed with four missiles was observed over Beirut's southern suburb before withdrawing southward, and Saudi Arabia's Najran region reported sirens without damage.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous Iranian missile launches and air defense activations across Khuzestan and West Azerbaijan indicate heightened military readiness amid regional tensions. Lebanon's 149 alerts, including 89 drone detections, and the armed Hermes-450 over Beirut signal escalating Israeli-Hezbollah confrontation. In Ukraine, the coordinated drone wave from six airbases and the USV strike near Libya show sustained Russian stand-off strike capacity and an expanding asymmetric maritime threat far from the Black Sea.
